negative_reviews.author: Veronica Hamid
negative_reviews.text:
Food and atmosphere were excellent. The food came to the table all separately with some of the group having finished when the other food came out. Several times chasing for the food.
Kitchen staff should plan meal readiness times more adequately to ensure all food comes out together.

issues: Southampton took £42K with wages at 23.3%, against a £40,000 target, with record sales on Saturday (Admin Meeting 09/11 and GM/HC meeting 09/11).
Daily labour has come down from 33 to 35% to 22 to 23% over two months, making it the strongest site in South England with strong margins (London KPI meeting 10/11).
62 five star reviews came in last week, the rating is 4.82 across 74 reviews, and spend per head rose to £21.82.
One 3 star review praised the food and atmosphere but said dishes arrived separately and had to be chased, so BOH speed and timing need work.
Labour cost and spend per head are the areas to improve.
Staffing: a new floor supervisor and a new sushi chef have joined.
The lunch deal is performing well at Southampton (Admin Meeting 09/11).
The knife sharpening quote has been received, and the site is still waiting for its delivery rider tags (Admin Meeting 09/11).
Promotions: Slerp 50% off and the Christmas set menu.
